seq_consecutiveb.note: seq_consecutiveb s u v: (u, v) or (v, u) is a pair of zip s (behead s), the Boolean form of seq_consecutive (seq_consecutivebP); empty and one-entry sequences use nothing, a repeated adjacent value uses its loop pair, a cyclic closing pair is not used unless adjacent.

alt_uses.note: alt_uses b x p a c: some step of x :: p, read with polarity b flipping at every step, is (a, c) forward at polarity true and backward at polarity false; the empty tail uses nothing; any Type, propositional equality, no validity requirement.
